Semantic archive and durable records (distinct owners)
|
|-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService (App service)
|   `-- contexts: WeakMap<CanvasEditingContext, CanvasHistory>
|       `-- CanvasHistory (isolated per open context)
|           |-- CanvasHistoryRecord
|           |   |-- headId / baselineId / past[] / future[]
|           |   |-- snapshots[id]: StoredCanvasSnapshot
|           |   |   |-- document: CanvasDocument, composition without contents
|           |   |   |-- diagramBindings: content IDs -> exact revision IDs
|           |   |   `-- view + nodeOrigins + optional transactionId
|           |   |-- diagramRevisions: retained exact versions
|           |   `-- canvasViews: named recordings outside undo-restored state
|           |-- document(): composition + bindings + revisions -> resolved document
|           |-- append / navigate / forkContext / adopt (service entry points)
|           `-- Cross-canvas transfers: linked boundaries require workspace undo
|
|-- Diagram revision registry (module-level, not controller-owned)
|   `-- createStoredDiagram / reviseStoredDiagram -> retain; resolve revisions by ID
|
|-- WorkspacePersistence (page-owned adapter)
|   |-- Subscriptions: workspace.onPersist(ids) + SourcePaneViewState
|   |-- Per-session cursors -> controller.persistenceChanges(cursor)
|   `-- Delta + metadata + baseline + personal view -> RecordStorage.batch()
|       `-- Share content-addressed items; do not resend unchanged history
|
|-- WorkspaceStorage (App service)
|   |-- RecordStorage: cache, pending-key map, one in-flight batch
|   |   `-- requestId + expectedRevision: stable retry identity and concurrency check
|   |-- Worker: encode batch -> POST /api/mapping/workspace/records
|   `-- flush(): await acknowledgement; dispose() alone does not guarantee a flush
|
`-- WorkspaceRecordStore (server-side persistence)
    |-- apply(): serialize writes; verify retry receipt and expected revision
    |-- Validate records; revisions/items and checkpoint semantics are immutable
    |   `-- Checkpoint encoding and transfer links may change under validation
    `-- Write content-addressed JSON -> atomically replace manifest
        `-- Manifest publishes references, workspace revision and retry receipt
